items.summary: Islamic inheritance (Faraid, Mirath, Meeras, Wirasat, Waris) calculator and guide. items.summary: Use when drying laundry on a rack indoors (or outdoors): computes hours-to-dry from vapor-pressure-deficit evaporation physics and spin-speed residual moisture, the kg of water the load dumps into your air, the room RH rise (condensation risk), and the cheapest drying method comparison (rack vs dehumidifier vs heated airer vs tumble dryer kWh).

- Added a laundry drying forecaster for estimating drying time, residual water, indoor humidity rise, and condensation risk.
- Added drying-finish verdicts and cost comparisons across racks, dehumidifiers, heated airers, and tumble dryers.
- Included indoor and outdoor scenarios, including airflow effects, ventilation, and below-freezing drying.
- Added guidance on model assumptions, common pitfalls, and verification checks.

items.summary: Use when windows fog/weep/frost on the inside in winter: computes the inner-pane surface temperature for your glazing (U-value + film coefficients), finds the condensation RH threshold for each window class, diagnoses cause (too humid / too cold glass / thermal bridging / lifestyle moisture sources), and gives the target indoor RH + ventilation fix with mold-risk timing.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of humidity-window-fog-doctor.

- Calculates inner-pane temperature and condensation RH thresholds for different glazing types.
- Diagnoses likely causes, including high indoor humidity, cold glass, curtains, and household moisture sources.
- Provides RH targets, ventilation guidance, and glazing-side fixes, with mold-risk context.
- Includes command-line examples and JSON output support.
